text: Describe the final preparations for a trip with your family or with your school, and the moment of
departure.
OR
Imagine you return to your school or college long after the end of the school day. Describe what
you see and hear, and your thoughts and feelings as you walk through the building.
OR
Narrative Writing
Write a story about a time when you lost something important.
OR
Write a story with the title, ‘The Lie’.
